note: control[0] must equal P2MR_LEAF_VERSION (194 / 0xc2) exactly. Masking with P2MR_LEAF_MASK (0xfe) would accept 0xc3 as 0xc2 (wtxid malleability). VerifyP2MRCommitment must bind the control block to the 32-byte witness v2 program. Native tests fill the committed leaf/program from derivation.json, then apply one of these mutations.

cases.note: 0xc0 is TAPROOT_LEAF_TAPSCRIPT, not P2MR_LEAF_VERSION. Interpreter returns SCRIPT_ERR_P2MR_WRONG_LEAF_VERSION.
0xc3 is P2MR_LEAF_VERSION with the unused odd bit set. Exact comparison rejects it (SCRIPT_ERR_P2MR_WRONG_LEAF_VERSION); a masked check would validate it as 0xc2.
Leaf version 0xc2 with a sibling hash that does not reproduce the 32-byte program. VerifyP2MRCommitment fails (SCRIPT_ERR_WITNESS_PROGRAM_MISMATCH).
